title: ornithogalum duthiae
intro: Ornithogalum duthiae, commonly known as Duthie's Starflower, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, fever, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum duthiae are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
